verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken banner layout. The five flavour chips are split into three places: Wild Honey floats in the top right, Rosemary in the bottom right, and the other three sit in a row next to the CTA. The legal text floats in mid-air on the right. 'Build Your Mix' is a tiny pill jammed under the headline and no more prominent than the chips beside it, so the CTA is buried. The chip row also crowds the bottom edge. A shrinks the can to a small thumbnail pinned to the left edge, which weakens the product. B keeps the can at a more faithful size, but its Elderflower chip is cramped, with the label touching the pill edges, so B is only slightly less bad.
